We left early in the morning.
The road was empty and the sky was clear.
By noon we reached the coast.

Thanks for the update.
I will read the notes tonight and reply tomorrow.
Talk soon.

Dear Sam,
The garden looks lovely this week.
The roses finally opened.

The book has a soft cover.
It is about ninety pages long.
My aunt gave it to me.

He opened the letter slowly.
Inside was a short note from his brother.
He smiled.

The recipe is simple.
Mix the flour and the eggs.
Bake for twenty minutes.

First we went to the market.
Then we bought some fish.
Later we cooked dinner.

The meeting went well today.
Everyone agreed on the plan.
We start on Monday.
